title: Cobblemon Masterball Block
description: This project makes it such that the Cobblemon Masterball wiggles 3 times and fails, everytime.
body: Makes Masterballs wiggle 3 times and let the pokemon out every time. Made because my friend keeps cheating in masterballs and its cringe. Made more of a learning project than anything else, but fairly rigorously tested on a dedicated server in a variety of cases, in Cobbleverse modpack. Made with the help of Claude.
